semiconductor_relevance: High — Accuracy Assembly Automation Co., Ltd specializes in pick and place equipment and advanced packaging solutions for the semiconductor industry.
summary: Accuracy Assembly Automation Co., Ltd, based in Suzhou, China, is a prominent provider of pick and place equipment tailored for the semiconductor sector. With 16 years of experience in micro-assembly, the company offers advanced die bonding solutions and technologies for various applications including IC packaging and optoelectronics.

regional_presence.China: The company is headquartered in Suzhou, China, focusing on the semiconductor equipment market.
